pyramiding_rule: Prohibit grid-style averaging or adding positions within 15 seconds of a prior stop-out; only pyramid when existing open positions demonstrate at least +$10.00 floating profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandate a 3-period exponential moving average (EMA) slope confirmation combined with zero high-impact macroeconomic news releases within a +/- 10-minute window before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger partial scaling or aggressive breakeven lock once floating profit hits +$12.00 to prevent evaporation, allowing the remainder to run toward the +$15.00 to +$30.00 target.
